name: John Walker
summary: Scottish naturalist and Professor of Natural History at the University of Edinburgh known for his chemically-based mineralogical classification system.

name: University of Edinburgh
summary: Scottish university where Walker served as Professor of Natural History.

name: William Cullen
summary: Edinburgh physician and chemist who instructed Walker during the 1750s.

name: Joseph Black
summary: Edinburgh chemist and contemporary of Walker whose lecture notes were published in 1803.

name: Torbern Olaf Bergman
summary: Swedish chemist whose Outlines of Mineralogy influenced Walker's system.

name: David Pollock
summary: Law student at Edinburgh who took detailed stenographed notes of Walker's 1797 lectures.

name: Schediasma Fossilium
summary: Walker's first comprehensive mineralogical system created in 1781 consisting of eighteen classes.

name: Classes Fossilium
aliases: Classes Fossilium: Sive, Characteres Naturales et Chymici Classium et Ordinum in Systemate Minerali
summary: 1787 publication containing augmentations of Walker's Schediasma Fossilium.

name: Institutes of Natural History
aliases: Institutes of Natural History; Containing the Heads of Lectures in Natural History
summary: 1792 publication containing the heads of Walker's lectures.

name: Systema Fossilium
summary: Walker's final mineralogical system created around 1795 consisting of nineteen classes.
